title: Constrained Decoding
motto: Ask an LLM for JSON. Get JSON most of the time. In production, "most" is the problem. Constrained decoding turns "most" into "always" by editing the logits before sampling.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Ask an LLM for JSON. Get JSON most of the time. In production, "most" is the problem. Constrained decoding turns "most" into "always" by editing the logits before sampling.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: A classifier prompts an LLM: "Return one of {positive, negative, neutral}." The model returns "The sentiment is positive — this review is overwhelmingly favorable because the customer explicitly states that they ...". Your parser crashes. Your classifier's F1 is 0.0.
Free-form generation is not a contract. It is a suggestion. A production system needs a contract.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Force JSON/grammar valid tokens during generation.
